messages:
maya: heads-up — after today's deploy I'm seeing viewers with Edit buttons in the console. cc @sec-oncall @jon
jon: I can repro. Viewer on org-42 sees 'Edit project' and can hit save in the UI. Tried incognito to rule out cached perms.
lina: preliminary: role mapping change landed that flips a display flag on project.viewer. grabbing the commit.
alex: found it — commit 3f9ab2 in platform/console. Looks like an 'implicit_editor' flag got set true by accident. snippet:
```yaml
roles:
  project.viewer:
    can_view: true
    can_edit: false
    implicit_editor: true
```
sam: that flag was intended for an internal staging experiment, not prod. sorry — we should rollback. :grimacing:
eng-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for commit 3f9ab2 -> reverting to 2c7d9a. ETA ~6m.
cory: also saw a KMS access warning around the same time for org-42: failed to fetch encryption key during attempted project update. might be related.
sec-oncall: this is potentially privilege escalation + KMS auth anomaly. triage: collect logs (console policy eval, auth tokens, kms errors). assigning owners: @maya logs, @cory kms queries, @lina code revert/patch.
maya: logs pasted below:
```
2026-03-20T15:12:34Z ERROR auth: policy_eval: org=org-42 user=alice allowed=true source=ui action=project.update reason="implicit_editor"
2026-03-20T15:12:36Z WARN kms: access_denied key=projects/org-42/kms/main err=UNAUTHENTICATED
```
jon: policy_eval allowing project.update despite role=viewer is the core bug. looks like the 'implicit_editor' flag short-circuits checks in the new policy evaluator.
lina: I'll open an immediate PR to revert the flag and add a unit test asserting UI gating for viewer roles. will also add an audit-log assertion for KMS failures.
sam: mitigation: frontend will stop rendering Edit controls based solely on client-side flags. server-side permission check gating until RBAC fix is merged. I have a quick PR ready.
sec-oncall: TL;DR next steps: 1) finish rollback (eng-bot) 2) investigate KMS UNAUTHENTICATED — likely token refresh or creds rotated during deploy 3) run queries to find any orgs/users who executed project.update 15:12-15:18 4) notify affected orgs and rotate keys if data-modifying actions occurred. postmortem if any writes happened. keep this thread updated.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2334012360. running synthetic checks against console routes. no further editor exposures observed :white_check_mark:
cory: running DB/audit-query now to list project.update events between 2026-03-20T15:12:00Z and 2026-03-20T15:18:00Z. will report counts shortly.
maya: thanks — if any org shows writes, we'll contact security/comms and rotate keys. scheduling 1hr after-action call at 16:30.
jon: adding 'implicit_editor' to forbidden flags in release checklist and adding a gating QA test for the REST policy eval path.
